correctness.rationale: For a factor occurring uniquely, minimality is equivalent to both one-symbol truncations recurring. One-run unique maxima, two-transition rectangles with single boundary exits, three-run factors crossing exactly a full distinct middle run, and a unique proper three-run factor inside any four-plus-run candidate cover every contiguous factor. Separation ensures distinct maxima/transition lengths and exactly one possible eighth pattern. Ordered separated three-zero-run compositions have series 6 t^9/[(1−t³)(1−t²)(1−t)] and two one-run lengths 2 t^4/[(1−t²)(1−t)]; c is minimum in 2/6 orderings. Exceptional run pair separations failing have O(n³) compositions versus total Theta(n⁴). An independent literal frequency table checked every one of the 1800 separated five-tuples with entries <=7 and exactly matched the full proposed factor sets; these finite cases do not prove the theorem at all lengths.
residual_risks: Exceptional near-equal run lengths not classified; uniform model is five-part compositions, not random independent bits.
